testcase.name: file intake requires explicit config, consent, ownership and bounded one-time sessions
encrypted import survives service restart, never returns or audits secrets, and shares no quota
concurrent same-session, same-owner and cross-owner imports cannot duplicate or steal registration
DB/audit failure rolls back encrypted material, token consumption and deletion atomically
dispatcher keeps setup private, server-owned and rate-limited with safe invalid input recovery
owner list cursor is bounded and never exposes vault fields
intake status shares the default batch policy and never enables the receiver flag implicitly
additive SQL migration is repeatable and disabling intake preserves existing subscriptions and ordinary data
